P2_chirality_alignment_cw_cw_ccw_ccw.note: Cycle-order embedding: IGT_CW[k] → 2k in CB. CW on IGT [0,1,3,2] → CB [0,2,4,6] (all +2 mod 8 steps). CCW on IGT [0,2,3,1] → CB [0,6,4,2] (all +6 mod 8 steps).

P3_both_have_exactly_2_directed_hamilton.note: Cn always has exactly 2 directed Hamiltonian cycles (CW, CCW) up to rotation

N1_z3_unsat_chirality_reversing_embeddin.note: UNSAT: no injective edge-preserving embedding of IGT 4-ring into C8 can map a CW cycle to a CCW cycle; chirality reversal is structurally blocked. The +1 step constraint from edge-preservation conflicts with the -1 (CCW) step constraint, making the system unsatisfiable.

B1_intermediate_node_insertion_yields_ch.note: Inserting one intermediate node on each IGT 4-ring edge recovers C8 with perfect alternating-color structure = checkerboard ring. Intermediate nodes are structurally required: without them the IGT 4-ring and checkerboard 8-ring are incompatible in size.

B2_dihedral_group_embedding_d4_in_d8.note: D4 (Aut(C4)) embeds in D8 (Aut(C8)) with index 2; the IGT 4-ring automorphism group is a proper subgroup of the checkerboard 8-ring automorphism group, consistent with the 4-ring being a sublattice of the 8-ring.
